Name: Pick Me Girl (Leyley)
Author: Arimlaa
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley is full of sweet, supportive, and wholesome bachelors and bachelorettes. Leyley is not one of them.

Leyley is a brand new, fully fleshed-out Custom NPC designed to bring realistic, psychological "pick-me" drama to the valley. She thrives on male validation, constantly puts down other women in town (especially Haley, Abigail, and Penny), and uses weaponized fragility to get exactly what she wants. She will gaslight you, isolate you, and manipulate your feelings.[/color]
